logEntries.notes: Tuesday morning saw rorutue Went shore got what we wanted and off again.
This day a man was cere up in the main rigging and flag.
This day had dish water for Turkey sea pie.
At PM saw Sperm Whales lowered down and chased. Know no success.
At PM saw a ship steering to the south. Saw a breech at 6 o'clock.
Going under short sail. At PM saw a school of Black fish and for them no success. The waist boat got a bill fish.
Saw a school of sperm whales and lowered. But no success.
At PM saw a school of sperm whales lowered down. Never seen them afterward. Come on board again.
Steering into the land. Saw two sails. At PM spoke them found to be the ship Hope of New Bedford and the ship Zane from Fairhaven.

logEntries.course: between Coles Island and Colus rock
logEntries.notes: Saw a school of sperm whales lowered. But their legs longer than ours so we couldn't catch them. Saw three sails in sight. At PM spoke two ships. Their names were the Hope and the ship Omega of Nantucket.
Saw a sail at PM. Spoke her. It was the ship Commodore Morris of Falmouth.
At PM claim French rock in sight.
Saw a ship steering to the north.
Steering into the land. At PM calm.
Saw a sail.
Laying in Bay of Muckenut. The ship Trident of New Bedford.
Getting of water and stowing down of water.
This day the ship Clinton came in and the ship Lisbon.
The ship Tohankov of Fairhaven came in today.
This day weigh anchor. Saw a ship coming in.
This day put back to lea through that belong to other ship.
At PM spoke ship Alpha of Nantucket with one sperm.
This day saw a school of sperm whales lowered and struck one and took him alongside.
At PM saw land supposed to be the ocean island.
At PM brought up ocean island in sight.
Made Strong Island.
Saw the island of Guam. Laying off and on. The captain ashore.
Laying off and on. Saw the ship Napoleon of Nantucket.
Spoke the ship Nimrod of New Bedford bound to the north.
The ship Nimrod in sight.
Laying under close reef topsail. Spoke the ship Sea.
Saw two ships steering to the north.
Saw humpback. At night saw a whale don't know what kind of whale it was.
Made the land. At PM light wind. Saw two right lowered down. Know no success in the strait.
The ship South America.
Laying to under close reef topsail. The ship South America in sight. At PM saw ship head to the south and westward.
In the ice trying to get through but couldn't get through. Put back steering E b S.
Plenty of ice around. Laying back. At PM clear of steering N b W. At night came up thick laying back.
Saw ice. At PM steering SW.
At latter part lay to the head to the north. Ice in sight.
At AM spoke the ship Coral Cap. At PM saw whales lowered. Know no success. Plenty of ice in sight.
Steering to the wind.
At PM the weather same. Six ships in sight. Steering to the north and westward.
At PM rose whales and got one to waist struck. At latter part cut him in 11 o'clock had him on deck. This day saw number of ships.
At PM wore ship steering N by E. Busy boiling.
At PM spoke ship Floyaday of Fairhaven.
Busy stowing down oils. At PM spoke the barque Vernon of New Bedford.
Busy stowing down oil.
Took a dead whale alongside.
Busy boiling.

Tack ship.

Busy boiling, finishing a board. Saw a carcass.

Busy breaking out shook. Saw 6 ships steering to the westward.

Gossiping with the ship Mercury and the ship Lancaster.

logEntries.weather: heavy rain and heavy head sea
logEntries.notes: Very heavy sea on Double reef the Fore topsail & the Mainsail.
Fine weather, all sail on.
Commenced to moderate.
